acceptance_dimensions.silhouette_exterior_identity: VCF green research bands and glass crop-test crowns convert the annex into a polished agricultural development campus
acceptance_dimensions.interior_zoning_circulation: seed intake, durability chambers, spore-survival rooms, storage trials, reseeding plots and food-quality review are deliberately separated
acceptance_dimensions.functional_machinery_props: sealed grow cells, controlled soil beds, mycelial test strips, cooler banks and stored reseeding stock support repeatable commercial trials
acceptance_dimensions.institutional_identity: VCF green/white presentation and clean numbered test cells frame extreme persistence and distribution traits as product advantages
acceptance_dimensions.historical_damage_signature: the site is intentionally pre-crisis and largely intact; its disturbing signature is the escalating stress conditions built into successful test zones
acceptance_dimensions.narrative_evidence_loot: guaranteed EP-7 distribution and durability record establishes that survival, storage and reseeding persistence were engineered and celebrated
